gaps.explanation: The statement (p5, printed p18) is on the modified accrual basis. The Street, Housing Project and Debt Service schedules in detail[] are 'Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis' (pp13-15, printed pp57-59). Fund by fund: General Fund 756,942 = 756,942 (General Fund departments pp17-18). Other Funds 450,312 = nonmajor combining p16 (3,800 + 2,893 + 190,067 + 27,885 + 124,351 + 101,316). Debt Service 970,170 = 970,170. Street Fund: statement 240,031 (sales tax 40,513, intergovernmental 193,078, interest 3,710, other 2,730) vs cash-basis Total resources 249,417 (p13: 40,513, 193,078, interest 3,114, sale of property 10,325, other 2,387) = +9,386. Housing Project Fund: statement 129,253 (interest 253) vs cash-basis Total resources 129,221 (p14: interest 221) = -32. Net: +9,386 - 32 = +9,354, so the schedule is above the statement by the full gap of 9,354. These are cash vs modified-accrual differences in the printed totals, not missing or extra lines.

General Fund 701,056, Housing Project 205,779 and Other Funds 125,226 agree with detail[]. Street Fund: statement 164,691 (p5: public works 133,778 + capital outlay 25,975 + principal 4,938) vs cash-basis Total charges to appropriations 160,781 (p13: 134,806 + 25,975) = -3,910. Debt Service Fund: statement 1,267,276 (p5: 5,151 + 1,241,060 + interest 12,335 + bond fees 8,730) vs cash-basis 1,273,571 (p15: 5,151 + 1,241,060 + interest 18,630 + 8,730) = +6,295. Net: -3,910 + 6,295 = +2,385, so the schedule is above the statement by the full gap of 2,385. These are budgetary cash-basis vs modified-accrual differences.
